reason.description: Required (non-null) for origin=human on a judgement field.

version.description: record_version that this value was accepted in.

entity_record.description: Storage-neutral entity record. The backend stores entity_type plus a properties document; it validates properties against entity_types[entity_type].properties_schema of the schema_id the record names.

updated.description: Record last-change date used by the 90-day stale rule. Equals properties.updated where the type has it; for Account, Node and Signal (no updated in the code) it is the last accepted change.

record_version.description: ADR-K11: incremented by every accepted change; an edit names its base version.

field_provenance.description: ADR-K11: field name -> field_provenance_record, at least for every judgement field that has a value.

claim_record.description: Every relationship and every entity fact is carried by claims. Source rule: distinguish assertion from inference, assumed from verified, draft from reviewed.

rules.statement: Account is a customer that buys our instruments; Ecosystem is a supply-chain chip, module or certification partner. They are never mixed: one canonical_key never names both, and an Account reaches an Ecosystem only through suppliers (or a CustomerProduct through chip_modules).

Our TestSolution leaves vendor empty (no vendor link) and there is no Competitor card for our own company. A competitor's TestSolution has exactly one vendor link to its Competitor card. competing_solutions goes from our solution to a competitor's solution.
is_own_solution is required and equals 'has no vendor link'.
Solution coverage of an Application counts our solutions only; competitor solutions appear only in the comparison.

Every claim separates what the source says (source_assertion) from what we infer (inference), and states assumed / verified (verified only after checking) and draft / reviewed. Uncertain facts go to a to-verify list (verification_status=assumed), never stated as fact. Each claim from a deck cites its page.
claim_kind, verification_status, review_status and the evidence roles supports / contradicts / context follow kg.claim and kg.claim_evidence of v1.0.
A Concept starts as properties.review_status=draft (bi_schema.py:157) and becomes reviewed after sales have read it.

Every card records its sources and updated date; a card not updated for more than 90 days is flagged stale (Atlas graph_state stale, gap STALE_DATA). Note: the example Dashboard computes staleness from file.mtime, not updated, and only for Ecosystem, Technology, Trend and CustomerProduct (Dashboard.md section 8); AEP uses the record updated for every type.

bi_schema.py fixes no node list; Node layer is the code enum L1-L5 / X (bi_schema.py:129). The reference set is the 8 Node cards of the example vault (tests/fixtures/bi_vault_example/BI/Node/, owner rule 2026-10-18 'as many as seen'): L1-Chipset, L2-Antenna-Module, L2-RF-FEM-Module, L3-Handset, L3-WiFi-Router-CPE, L4-Base-Station, L5-Carrier-Network, X-Certification-Lab. Further positions are proposed-extension, pending owner acceptance.

Imports run dry-run first, are repeatable without duplicate cards, merge into existing cards without overwriting human-written text, keep extraction output out of the published set until reviewed, and keep only summaries and sources, not full source text.
rules.also: bi_ingest.py:15-17, 563-574, 588-597; tools/README.md:44-49. v1.3 tightens it to field level: ADR-K11.

rules.statement: A source_assertion claim has at least one supports evidence item.
An inference claim lists derived_from_claim_ids and is never verified; a reviewer qualifies the derived Opportunity instead.
A disputed claim has both supports and contradicts evidence.
A relationship's subject type is one of its sources' domains and its object type is in its range.
A record takes the highest classification of its evidence documents and its type default (ADR-K8 pending).
Labels of Account, CustomerProduct and Opportunity, or of any CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED record, are content (Knowledge API scope knowledge.read.content).

A competing_solutions target that resolves to a Competitor card is a type mismatch: it is not stored as competing_solutions; it is staged as a competing_vendors candidate with a warning. Nothing is inferred silently.

bi_ingest.py only warns when a link target card is missing (bi_ingest.py:722-727) and never checks the target's type. AEP stores a relationship only when the target resolves to an entity of a type in the range; an unresolved name becomes a vocabulary-gap candidate (v1.3 DQ-5).

Application.lifecycle (RD, Certification, Production, Reliability, Field; bi_schema.py:69-70) and CustomerProduct.test_stage_now (RD, cert, production; bi_schema.py:99) are different enums. Mapping: test_stage_now RD -> lifecycle RD; cert -> Certification; production -> Production. Reliability and Field have no test_stage_now value.

ADR-K11: an import or agent never overwrites a value whose field provenance origin is human; it creates a pending field proposal (conflict) for review. bi_ingest.py merge would overwrite it (new non-empty scalar overwrites, bi_ingest.py:563-574).
A card the source marks fictional or example (e.g. body text 虛構範例) is test data: synthetic=true, never trusted, its confidence is not taken as verified (v1.3 DQ-1).
confidence (verified|assumed) exists only on types with tail fields; Account, Node and Signal have none. Signal.reliability (high|medium|low) rates the source, not verification.

gap_checks.caveat: Dashboard.md section 6 counts any TestSolution inlink, so a planning solution or a competitor's solution hides the gap; AEP counts our solutions only and reports built (exists), sellable (status available) and ours (no vendor) separately.
Dashboard.md section 7 groups by confidence with WHERE confidence, so Account, Node and Signal (no field) are skipped; AEP reports the denominator.

upcast_from_v0.new_required_without_value: A v1-required property with no value after mapping takes the code default if bi_schema.py has one (bi_ingest.py:410-424); otherwise the record returns to review_status=draft and status=candidate. Example: Signal.summary (bi_schema.py:181) has no default.
steps: dry_run: report counts, renamed / unmapped names, value-map results, records sent back to candidate, conflicts with edited_by_human or human-set judgement fields
property_map per type; unmapped values move to properties.legacy_v0; mapped judgement values get field_provenance origin=migration and stay pending human confirmation

relationship_map; every renamed relationship gets a new relationship_id from the v1 name and an entry in relationship_id_map; claims keep claim_id, statement, modality and evidence, and their relationship pointer follows relationship_id_map
apply is idempotent by (entity_type, canonical_key) and relationship_id; document ids and evidence ids are never rewritten
